purpose: Post-training diagnosis on every literal user-commented ply; this corpus is diagnostic and cannot promote a model that failed locked full-match evaluation.
candidate_rule: Union of each actor's top-three complete semantic policy moves, capped at five. Physical wager IDs are deduplicated but draw sources remain distinct, so high-policy deck-versus-pile alternatives are compared. Never enumerate rollout values for every legal move.
world_model: Uniform hidden-card determinizations shared by every admitted move and reproducible across actors; exact ordered support replaces sampling at deck=2/3 when the requested budget covers it.
continuation: Each actor's production continuation checkpoint and role schedule, with exact one-card endings, semantic cycle handling, and cap-reserve completion.
belief_diagnostics: Each belief complaint reports both comparison actors' snapshot-only fixed-cardinality network marginals and a separate actor-aware posterior from the frozen perspective history. If rejection inference accepts no worlds, the result is explicitly marked insufficient rather than treating the snapshot head as history-conditioned evidence.
execution: Either manual workflow_dispatch or an auditable one-shot push: after the workflow is published, copy data/flagged_ply_audit_execution.template.json to data/flagged_ply_audit_execution.json, freeze the actual winner/reference actors, set execute=true, and add only that file in its commit. The real execution file is intentionally absent until launch.
reporting: The merge preserves every raw case row in JSON; tools/render_flagged_ply_audit.py deterministically produces a per-ply Markdown report with policy ranks/probabilities, admitted moves, common-panel Q/delta/SE, deployed moves, classifications, and both belief evidence types.
